events.title: NSP Q1 Deep Dive: Margin Recovery Progress, Growth Challenges, and Strategic Shifts
events.body: HR outsourcing provider Insperity (NYSE:NSP) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 1.7% year on year to $1.90 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.31 per share was 6.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
